item.title: My First Gallery
item.description:
This text appears below the photo slider, in the same spot as post body content. You can write as much or as little as you like here — or leave it blank and let the photos speak for themselves.

Drop your image files in this same folder (content/gallery/my-first-gallery/) alongside this index.md. They’ll appear in the slider automatically, sorted alphabetically — so prefix filenames with numbers to control the order:

  • 01-opening.jpg
  • 02-detail.jpg
  • 03-closing.jpg
